title: Deeper/broader open-source route and artifact-claim revalidation
mode: Primary-source project documentation and local-plan review; research-only update
scope: Revalidate candidate DWG/DXF reader, writer, converter, and application routes
Separate parser lineage from wrappers, ports, scene/render projections, and external conversion
Check license eligibility and test-corpus provenance before peer admission
Distinguish historical project metrics from current release/source qualification
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 optional peer admission protocol without changing local implementation order

sources.name: ft_model current README and historical project status
sources.observed: The project describes a C++20 direct DWG/DXF parser and a 2D SceneGraph/render path. PROJECT_STATUS.md explicitly labels itself historical/superseded and gives 2026-04-23 file-level comparison figures whose reference route is LibreDWG DWG-to-DXF plus ezdxf entity extraction. The current documented export is SceneGraph JSON. The README's planar SOLID route does not establish ACIS 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY, AcDs association, a B-rep kernel, or DWG/DXF writing. Treat this as a source-distinct but reference-correlated optional 2D projection candidate, not current or independent semantic qualification.

sources.name: UnCAD current route and scope
sources.observed: Current project documentation says UnCAD is read-only and exports a normalized model as JSON/SVG/PNG. DWG parsing uses LibreDWG through FFI; ASCII/Binary DXF R2007+ uses the separate undxf parser. No DWG/DXF writing or conversion is offered. Deduplicate the DWG route under LibreDWG and admit undxf only for an exact pinned DXF-read question.

sources.name: Zephyr current format-operation split
sources.observed: The README identifies DXF I/O as a Swift port of libdxfrw and DWG I/O as an ODA File Converter CLI bridge. These may support an optional application-consumer observation, but they are separate lineages and the reviewed README did not bind exact converter artifacts/arguments to an immutable application release. Do not count this as an independent open-source parser route.

sources.name: codelibs/libdxfrw fork and test provenance
sources.observed: The repository identifies itself as a fork of original libdxfrw and advertises test programs, but says test files are hosted in the separate fess-testdata repository. The reviewed docs do not bind the corpus license/provenance or establish release-bound behavior for current later DWG versions. Keep it as same-family source comparison; pin and audit source and test-data revisions before any optional run.

sources.name: Sea-DXF-Core / SeaCad stated license boundary
sources.observed: The README explicitly says the visible source is under a proprietary license and that visibility grants no permission to use, modify, or redistribute it; the first stated target is DXF. Exclude it from the open-source implementation matrix, code/test reuse, runtime dependencies, and support evidence unless a license change is documented and re-reviewed.

sources.name: Local DWG/DXF parity plan
sources.observed: These routes map to existing PAR-07/S8 evidence and consumer lanes. The update sharpens source eligibility, lineage, age, corpus provenance, and result-surface requirements without adding a local issue or mandatory peer execution.

assessment.planImpact: Refines the existing optional PAR-07/S8 peer-admission protocol. Each route must be scored by exact operation, parser lineage, immutable artifact, corpus/expected-result provenance, evidence age, and exposed result surface. Historical ft_model metrics remain historical and correlated with LibreDWG/ezdxf; UnCAD DWG is LibreDWG-derived; Zephyr splits libdxfrw-port DXF and ODA CLI DWG; codelibs is same-family; SeaCad is excluded under its stated proprietary license. No candidate promotes DWG/DXF semantic support or any deferred external J item.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source documentation review plus focused crosswalk against the existing local plan
method.limitations: All peer descriptions and metrics are project-authored documentation, not independent runtime results. No commit/release archives were built or run; test-corpus licensing and provenance were not independently audited; mutable main-branch docs can change. The results qualify candidate admission only and are not format authority, local defect evidence, or semantic support qualification.
